$comment: Ghost Ops AI Skill Configuration. Version-tracked in /docs/.system_state (ai_skills_version). Update this file when adding a new agent, retiring a skill, or changing routing logic.

assigned_task_types: EU AI Act Article 13/14/15 compliance gates

skills.name: Code Auditor
skills.trigger: PR contains pkg/evolution/ OR pkg/runtime/ OR pkg/api/ changes
skills.action: Run full security + logic audit. Flag any EU AI Act Article 15 violations.
skills.output: Review comment on PR with PASS/FAIL verdict and remediation steps.

skills.name: Architecture Reviewer
skills.trigger: New TASK-* with Token-Impact >= 4 added to /docs/BACKLOG.md
skills.action: Produce ADR skeleton in /docs/architecture/decisions.md. Identify risk level.
skills.output: ADR draft committed to feature branch.

skills.name: Standards Syncer
skills.action: Check EU AI Act implementing acts and ISO/IEC 42001 errata. Update /docs/STANDARDS.md and /docs/.system_state.
skills.output: PR with updated STANDARDS.md and bumped standards_last_synced timestamp.

assigned_task_types: Feature implementation after ADR is approved

skills.name: Feature Builder
skills.trigger: TASK status changes from BLOCKED to PENDING in /docs/BACKLOG.md
skills.action: Implement the feature per acceptance criteria. Write tests first (TDD). Target: 95% coverage, 0 lint.
skills.output: PR with implementation + tests. Reference Task ID in commit message.

skills.name: Test Expander
skills.trigger: Coverage report shows a package below 95%
skills.action: Identify uncovered paths. Generate table-driven tests for Go packages.
skills.output: PR adding missing test cases. Coverage delta reported in PR description.

skills.name: Benchmark Runner
skills.trigger: Task Acceptance Criteria mentions latency or throughput SLA
skills.action: Implement benchmark in *_benchmark_test.go. Compare vs baseline. Report p99.
skills.output: Benchmark results appended to PR description.

skills.name: Doc Generator
skills.trigger: TASK type == documentation AND status == PENDING
skills.action: Generate Markdown document per acceptance criteria. Follow flat-file hierarchy in /docs/STANDARDS.md § 5.
skills.output: New .md file committed to /docs/. PR raised with doc preview.

skills.name: Blueprint Author
skills.trigger: New service intent provided by operator
skills.action: Synthesize a Blueprint JSON matching the Ghost Ops schema (service_id, intent, constraints). Validate against JSON schema before submitting.

skills.name: Example Scaffolder
skills.trigger: TASK-608 or any task requiring new example code
skills.action: Generate minimal working example in examples/basic/<language>/. Include README and Makefile.
skills.output: PR with example directory. Build verified locally before PR raised.

never_used_for: Tasks requiring EU AI Act compliance review

skills.name: Boilerplate Generator
skills.trigger: New pkg/ directory created without initial files
skills.action: Generate interface stubs, error types, and test file skeleton.
skills.output: Inline suggestion or small PR with scaffolding files.

skills.name: Inline Refactorer
skills.trigger: lint error or code smell flagged in PR review
skills.action: Apply minimal fix. Do not change surrounding logic.
skills.output: Commit on the same branch fixing the specific violation.

redundancy_prevention.rule: Each task in /docs/BACKLOG.md carries exactly one Target Engine. No two agents should be assigned the same active task simultaneously.
redundancy_prevention.conflict_resolution: If two agents produce conflicting outputs, Claude Pro arbitrates. The higher Token-Impact engine's output takes precedence.
redundancy_prevention.prompt_deduplication: Before starting a task, check /docs/.system_state audit_log for prior attempts on the same Task ID. Do not re-synthesize if a completed entry exists.
